statusDetail: Coverage-complete report-mode audit. Anonymous browsing was exercised after essential-only consent and age confirmation. /video, /categories, /login and a deliberate missing path redirected to home; account creation, payment, upload, and authenticated management were not committed.

page.notes: Japanese adult-media site with consent and age gates, long recommendation feed, video detail, advertising and account entry surfaces.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-color-scheme and compared screenshots plus CSS media-rule probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Light and dark captures are byte-identical (141,208 bytes), and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme or color-scheme rule. The site is usable but hard-coded dark rather than preference-driven.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated reduced motion and queried document.getAnimations().
checkOutcomes.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the home page exposed zero active animations; no auto-advance was visible in the consent/age state.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated increased contrast and visually inspected the first viewport.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Controls and text remained visible in the prefers-contrast: more capture, including outlined consent and age-gate actions.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and recorded consent/age state changes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Shared-session CSS inspection found no view-transition usage; route/state changes in the gate-flow video are abrupt.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS for animation-timeline/scroll-timeline and observed scrolling surfaces.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, scrollytelling, entry reveal, or other scroll-linked motion was observed on the audited templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked animation exists to implement or assess.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered controls and CSS behavior across home and detail.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited browsing surfaces use native scrolling and ordinary controls; no custom pointer-driven gesture that fights platform behavior was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected long-page metrics and CSS for scroll-state patterns.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The long home feed has a 5,348px scroll height, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or shrinking/reactive header.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected overlay semantics and CSS for anchor positioning.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, context menu, or popover surface requiring anchored positioning was exposed in the representative anonymous paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No anchored overlay use case was present on the inspected paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected heading/focus structure and route states.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home and redirected listing/category states have no h1 and no directional transition; focus probes land on an unnamed button with outline-style none.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected initial screenshots and gate controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial consent and age gates cover content, but both are purpose-specific, clearly explained, and provide direct essential-only/enter/exit choices rather than an unrelated promotion.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered overlay semantics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The age/consent overlays are custom div structures: the shared-session probe found 0 dialog, popover, details, and role=dialog elements.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed post-gate screenshot/text and control geometry.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home feed interleaves repeated advertising/removal upsells and 49 of 150 visible controls are under 24px, crowding the primary content.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured mobile layout metrics across representative paths.
checkOutcomes.evidence: All five 360x800 layout captures reported scrollWidth=clientWidth=360 and horizontalOverflowPx=0; viewport metadata is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected loaded styles for container queries.
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSS inspection across home and detail found no @container/container-type usage; reused cards rely only on page-level layout rules.

checkOutcomes.method: Focused a live control and measured visible target geometry.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The focus probe reported outline-style none on the first focusable control, and 49/150 home controls plus 33/76 detail controls measured under 24px.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first-view and post-gate screenshots plus headings.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The required age gate clearly states the site purpose and offers explicit enter/exit actions; the detail page exposes its title and player immediately after entry.

checkOutcomes.method: Executed a shared-profile gate-to-detail journey.
checkOutcomes.evidence: An anonymous user can accept essential cookies, confirm age, browse the feed, and reach a video detail with title and player controls.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigated to a deliberate 404 path in the shared session and inspected resulting URL/body.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A deliberate nonexistent URL resolves to the home feed without a visible not-found explanation or recovery state, making the failure indistinguishable from success.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse and DevTools traces on home and video detail.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured home LCP 4.4s/CLS 0.697 and video LCP 6.1s/CLS 0.609; the trace measured video LCP at 21.8s in its longer capture.

checkOutcomes.method: Combined Lighthouse layout-shift attribution with layout observer and image audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse attributed CLS 0.608 primarily to the late cookie banner and also found unsized advertising media; the mobile layout primitive independently observed CLS 0.101.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared trace long tasks with Lighthouse TBT/main-thread breakdown.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace summaries found no >50ms long tasks and 0ms trace TBT; Lighthouse TBT remained 50ms home and 160ms detail despite 2.2-2.9s total main-thread work.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR summaries and confirmed resource placement signals against DOM/CSS evidence.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home loaded 172 requests/5.20MB with at least seven parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets and multiple parser scripts; video loaded 132 requests/3.08MB.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse code-efficiency audits and HAR type counts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse failed unused CSS and unused JavaScript on both templates; home ships 40 scripts and detail 50 scripts.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility audits and image inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found untitled ad iframes on home and unnamed player buttons on detail; the detail image audit also found one image without alt.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse contrast audits and inspected prefers-contrast screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither Lighthouse run reported a color-contrast failure, and text/controls stayed legible in the increased-contrast capture.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected headings/landmarks/focus and Lighthouse structure audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home has no h1 and only a header landmark; Lighthouse found heading-order issues on detail, while focused controls can have outline-style none.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually inspected screenshots and mobile layout metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Japanese gate copy and content titles are readable at desktop and mobile widths without clipping or horizontal overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured control targets and inspected video track elements.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile reflow succeeds, but dozens of controls are under 24px and the primary video elements expose no caption tracks.

checkOutcomes.method: Collected Lighthouse console audit and Runtime/Log events.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse logged a null addEventListener exception; shared-session CDP captured repeated null.style TypeErrors from generated-lib.js.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected document metadata and image dimensions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but image audits found 3 missing dimensions on home and 7 on detail, including the detail poster.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices/platform audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found deprecated Cast-control CSS, deprecated unload listeners, BFCache blockers, and inspector issues.

checkOutcomes.method: Read rendered head metadata across representative paths.
checkOutcomes.evidence: All inspected paths use the generic title “Pornhub” and omit meta descriptions; even the specific video page lacks a descriptive document title.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected robots/viewport/anchors and Lighthouse SEO audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The viewport is mobile-friendly, but pages declare noindex,nofollow and home contains 18 javascript: links; Lighthouse failed crawlable anchors/robots.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared final URLs, canonical links, and robots metadata.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The video detail and redirected templates canonicalize to the home URL while also declaring noindex,nofollow, preventing stable page-level indexing signals.

checkOutcomes.method: Parsed JSON-LD and Open Graph elements on the detail page.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The video detail exposes neither JSON-LD nor Open Graph metadata despite representing a rich media entity.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected main-document headers and CDP cookies.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS are present, but CSP and nosniff are missing; the rp cookie is not Secure and uses SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR third-party totals and tracker inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home made 101 third-party requests totaling 2.15MB across 11 origins, including Google Tag Manager and DoubleClick, even in the initial consent state.

checkOutcomes.method: Observed load behavior and inspected initial controls for auth affordances.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No geolocation/notification prompt appeared on load, and the initial controls include a passkey continuation banner rather than a password-only prompt.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected browser-enforced response policies.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Clickjacking protection and HSTS exist, but CSP, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and nosniff are absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran raw-HTML versus rendered discoverability captures.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw responses contain 475-501KB of HTML, are not JS shells, preserve title and the video h1, and expose 32-36% rendered-word overlap without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigated representative routes in a shared authenticated-age session and recorded final URLs.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Public /video, /categories, and /login navigation attempts resolve back to the home URL in the shared session without an explanatory state.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked manifest and service-worker registrations.
checkOutcomes.evidence: This media-streaming site is intrinsically network-dependent; no product intent indicating installability/offline playback was found.
checkOutcomes.reason: Offline/installable behavior is contextual and not expected for this anonymous streaming surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Exercised a failed route and inspected final state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The deliberate nonexistent path silently becomes the homepage rather than showing a useful not-found/retry/recovery state.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected lang/dir, loaded CSS, and rendered Japanese pages.
checkOutcomes.evidence: html lang=ja is correct, but CSS inspection found no logical properties and 14 physical left/right declarations on home (130 on detail), while visible UI mixes untranslated English.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered locale-sensitive labels and lang metadata.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Visible counts and age text are localized (for example “6 年前”), and the page consistently declares Japanese.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered data and forms for time-zone-sensitive concepts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No schedules, absolute timestamps, recurring events, or cross-zone date entry appeared in the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited browsing and playback surfaces expose no time-zone-sensitive task.

checkOutcomes.method: Observed post-consent shared session and reviewed navigation/feed copy.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After essential-only consent, a persistent banner asks users to “Accept All Cookies”; the feed repeatedly inserts paid destinations and “remove ads” upsells among content.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected all rendered forms and required fields.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative anonymous task exposes search but no required user-editable form with an invalid submission state; no safe validation workflow was available without account creation.
checkOutcomes.reason: No applicable required form-validation flow exists in the audited anonymous surfaces.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected all rendered fields, labels, and autocomplete attributes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The visible search input has an accessible label and no address/payment/sign-up fields requiring autocomplete tokens were rendered; passkey continuation is offered separately.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed anonymous gates, navigation, and account entry affordances.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Anonymous browsing does not force a subscription or payment commitment; login remains optional and the initial UI advertises passkey continuation.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image delivery inventories on home and detail.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home has 33 images without srcset and 22 legacy-format images; detail has 16 without srcset, 13 legacy images, and one oversized avatar.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR network totals and offenders.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial home state issues 172 requests and 5.20MB, including 38 XHR/fetch requests and duplicated GTM payloads before the primary content is used.

checkOutcomes.method: Analyzed HAR third-party bytes and tracker origins.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 101 requests/2.15MB; TrafficJunky alone transfers about 939KB and GTM about 468KB, disproportionate before a user starts media.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected markup/scripts for WebMCP and agentic tool registration.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No declared agent-facing task or structured WebMCP capability is expected for this public adult-media browsing surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: The emerging agent-capability principle is contextual and this site exposes no intended agent-facing workflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected markup/scripts for built-in AI APIs.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarization, language-model, or other inference feature is part of the observed product experience.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user task in the audited surface calls for on-device inference.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared baseline and post-interaction heap summaries after ten real overlay cycles.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After 10 cookie-customization open/back cycles the collected heap was 39.39MB versus 37.41MB baseline (+5.3%); garbage collection completed and no unbounded pattern was demonstrated in this bounded run.

checkOutcomes.method: Judged heap totals against page complexity.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home page retained about 37.4MB in the baseline heap; this is substantial but proportionate to a script/ad-heavy media homepage and remained under 40MB after exercise.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared constructor summaries before/after repeated overlay interaction.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither heap summary surfaced Detached* constructors among the largest retained constructor groups, and the ten-cycle run did not show explosive node growth.

principleOutcomes.reason: The emerging agent-capability principle is contextual and this site exposes no intended agent-facing workflow. No user task in the audited surface calls for on-device inference.

paths.description: Entry, consent/age gating, global navigation, recommendation feed
Primary video listing route; redirected to home in shared session
Category navigation route; redirected to home in shared session
Primary video content/detail and media journey
Authentication route/entry; direct route redirected home, passkey entry was visible in initial controls
Deliberate missing route used to inspect recovery behavior

findings.summary: Hard-coded dark theme ignores the user color-scheme preference
findings.evidence: Light and dark captures are byte-identical (141,208 bytes), and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme or color-scheme rule. The site is usable but hard-coded dark rather than preference-driven.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and preference-driven surface tokens with light-dark() or prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: Shared-session CSS inspection found no view-transition usage; route/state changes in the gate-flow video are abrupt.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful state/route changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long-feed chrome does not respond to scroll state
findings.evidence: The long home feed has a 5,348px scroll height, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or shrinking/reactive header.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained sticky-header state or progress/scrollability affordance using scroll-state/container techniques where supported.

findings.summary: Navigation does not reliably guide attention or focus
findings.evidence: Home and redirected listing/category states have no h1 and no directional transition; focus probes land on an unnamed button with outline-style none.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide one clear page heading, preserve visible focus, and cue the destination after navigation.

findings.summary: Consent and age gates do not use semantic modal primitives
findings.evidence: The age/consent overlays are custom div structures: the shared-session probe found 0 dialog, popover, details, and role=dialog elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement true modal behavior with dialog, focus trapping/restoration, Escape/platform dismissal where legally appropriate, and accessible names.

findings.summary: Advertising and upsell chrome crowds the content feed
findings.evidence: The home feed interleaves repeated advertising/removal upsells and 49 of 150 visible controls are under 24px, crowding the primary content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce repeated ad/removal prompts, visually separate paid destinations, and prioritize the content grid.

findings.summary: Reusable cards do not use component-level responsiveness
findings.evidence: CSS inspection across home and detail found no @container/container-type usage; reused cards rely only on page-level layout rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable grid/card modules containment and @container rules so behavior follows available space.

findings.summary: Focus visibility and target sizes are inadequate
findings.evidence: The focus probe reported outline-style none on the first focusable control, and 49/150 home controls plus 33/76 detail controls measured under 24px.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a clear outline and expand interactive hit areas to at least 24px, preferably 44px for primary touch actions.
findings.guidanceId: touch target size hover fallback pointer input focus-visible

findings.summary: Missing routes do not expose a clear recovery state
findings.evidence: A deliberate nonexistent URL resolves to the home feed without a visible not-found explanation or recovery state, making the failure indistinguishable from success.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a genuine 404 with an explicit message, search/home links, and preserved context.
findings.guidanceId: loading empty error success retry undo cancel state

findings.summary: Core Web Vitals are outside good thresholds
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured home LCP 4.4s/CLS 0.697 and video LCP 6.1s/CLS 0.609; the trace measured video LCP at 21.8s in its longer capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP element, defer noncritical ads/scripts, and reserve all late content space; validate LCP under 2.5s and CLS under 0.1.

findings.summary: Cookie and ad insertion causes severe layout shift
findings.evidence: Lighthouse attributed CLS 0.608 primarily to the late cookie banner and also found unsized advertising media; the mobile layout primitive independently observed CLS 0.101.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve banner/ad dimensions before paint and avoid injecting layout-affecting content above existing content.

findings.summary: Network delivery is heavy and render-blocking
findings.evidence: Home loaded 172 requests/5.20MB with at least seven parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets and multiple parser scripts; video loaded 132 requests/3.08MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer noncritical styles/scripts, preload only true critical assets, and apply durable caching.

findings.summary: Large amounts of unused CSS and JavaScript ship on entry
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed unused CSS and unused JavaScript on both templates; home ships 40 scripts and detail 50 scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template, conditionally load ad/player dependencies, and remove duplicate/legacy bundles.

findings.summary: Player controls and ad frames lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found untitled ad iframes on home and unnamed player buttons on detail; the detail image audit also found one image without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Name every media button and iframe, label form controls, and preserve meaningful image alternatives.

findings.summary: Heading, landmark, and keyboard-focus structure is weak
findings.evidence: Home has no h1 and only a header landmark; Lighthouse found heading-order issues on detail, while focused controls can have outline-style none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one h1 per page, logical heading order/main/nav landmarks, and a consistently visible focus indicator.
findings.guidanceId: heading structure landmarks focus order keyboard

findings.summary: Small targets and missing caption tracks limit comparable media access
findings.evidence: Mobile reflow succeeds, but dozens of controls are under 24px and the primary video elements expose no caption tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target sizes and provide synchronized captions/transcripts for video content.

findings.summary: The page throws runtime exceptions
findings.evidence: Lighthouse logged a null addEventListener exception; shared-session CDP captured repeated null.style TypeErrors from generated-lib.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard missing elements before binding/reading styles and add regression tests for each template and consent state.

findings.summary: Images lack intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but image audits found 3 missing dimensions on home and 7 on detail, including the detail poster.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio for logos, posters, and ad creative before loading.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found deprecated Cast-control CSS, deprecated unload listeners, BFCache blockers, and inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unload handlers and deprecated media-control CSS, then resolve DevTools inspector/BFCache diagnostics.

findings.summary: Titles are generic and meta descriptions are missing
findings.evidence: All inspected paths use the generic title “Pornhub” and omit meta descriptions; even the specific video page lacks a descriptive document title.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate unique localized titles and concise descriptions for home, listings, categories, and each video.

findings.summary: Robots policy and JavaScript links prevent crawling
findings.evidence: The viewport is mobile-friendly, but pages declare noindex,nofollow and home contains 18 javascript: links; Lighthouse failed crawlable anchors/robots.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations and align robots/meta policy with the intended public discoverability of each page.
findings.guidanceId: crawlable links viewport meta robots descriptive link text

findings.summary: Canonical and indexing signals collapse detail pages to home
findings.evidence: The video detail and redirected templates canonicalize to the home URL while also declaring noindex,nofollow, preventing stable page-level indexing signals.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each public detail a self-referencing canonical and consistent robots/sitemap/hreflang signals.
findings.guidanceId: canonical hreflang http status robots sitemap noindex seo indexing

findings.summary: Video pages lack structured and social metadata
findings.evidence: The video detail exposes neither JSON-LD nor Open Graph metadata despite representing a rich media entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD plus localized Open Graph/Twitter metadata matching visible content.
findings.guidanceId: structured data schema.org json-ld open graph social preview metadata

findings.summary: Transport protection is incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS are present, but CSP and nosniff are missing; the rp cookie is not Secure and uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP and nosniff; mark all HTTPS cookies Secure and avoid SameSite=None unless cross-site use is required.

findings.summary: The initial page has a large tracking footprint
findings.evidence: Home made 101 third-party requests totaling 2.15MB across 11 origins, including Google Tag Manager and DoubleClick, even in the initial consent state.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay optional analytics/ads until valid consent, reduce vendors, and batch/minimize collected events.

findings.summary: Key browser-enforced defensive policies are absent
findings.evidence: Clickjacking protection and HSTS exist, but CSP, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and nosniff are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, nosniff, and frame-ancestors while preserving existing HSTS.

findings.summary: Primary navigation routes silently fall back to home
findings.evidence: Public /video, /categories, and /login navigation attempts resolve back to the home URL in the shared session without an explanatory state.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep destination routes stable and render an explicit error when content cannot load rather than substituting home.

findings.summary: HTTP/network failure recovery is not explicit
findings.evidence: The deliberate nonexistent path silently becomes the homepage rather than showing a useful not-found/retry/recovery state.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide intentional 404/network/timeout states with retry, back, search, and home actions.

findings.summary: Japanese localization is not layout-robust
findings.evidence: html lang=ja is correct, but CSS inspection found no logical properties and 14 physical left/right declarations on home (130 on detail), while visible UI mixes untranslated English.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt logical CSS properties, remove untranslated UI strings, and test longer/RTL strings even if Japanese remains the primary locale.

findings.summary: Post-consent nagging and paid destinations reduce trust
findings.evidence: After essential-only consent, a persistent banner asks users to “Accept All Cookies”; the feed repeatedly inserts paid destinations and “remove ads” upsells among content.
findings.suggestedFix: Honor essential-only consent without repeated pressure and make every paid placement unmistakable and proportionate.

findings.summary: Images are not responsively or format optimized
findings.evidence: Home has 33 images without srcset and 22 legacy-format images; detail has 16 without srcset, 13 legacy images, and one oversized avatar.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate srcset/sizes, modern AVIF/WebP variants, and right-sized thumbnails/posters.

findings.summary: Entry load performs wasteful background work
findings.evidence: The initial home state issues 172 requests and 5.20MB, including 38 XHR/fetch requests and duplicated GTM payloads before the primary content is used.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer background fetches and analytics until idle/consented, and remove duplicate startup work.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and ads exceed a proportionate entry budget
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 101 requests/2.15MB; TrafficJunky alone transfers about 939KB and GTM about 468KB, disproportionate before a user starts media.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, lazy-load media/ads, and remove low-value vendors.

Reduce advertising, tracking, and third-party startup cost
Fix unique metadata, canonicals, robots, and structured video data
taskList.guidanceId: structured data schema.org json-ld open graph social preview metadata

taskList.title: Deploy CSP and complete browser security policies
Split unused code and remove deprecated/runtime-broken paths
Make overlays and route failures semantic and recoverable
Improve responsive components, navigation cues, and preference handling
